home.title: Near & Wise IP Law Office | Seoul
home.description: Engineer-trained patent attorneys connect prosecution, disputes, valuation and value realisation in one team.
home.heroTitle:
Filing is the beginning.
Value realisation is the goal.
home.heroLede: Our engineer-trained patent attorneys understand the technology first. One team carries the matter from filing through disputes, valuation and realisation.
home.panel: Start with the path that fits the purpose of your rights.
home.startBody: The right response depends on where you are and what the matter needs to achieve. The attorney in charge stays with you from the beginning.

entries.title: Companies & R&D
entries.body: We structure domestic and international filings, registration, dispute response and value realisation around each stage of the business.

entries.title: Foreign associates
entries.body: Direct Korean representation for inbound matters. The responsible attorney responds personally and keeps the technical context intact.

entries.title: IP firms
entries.body: We manage overseas patent annuities and trademark renewals through a trusted international network.

home.aboutTitle:
Near to our clients.
Wise in strategy.
home.aboutLead: Obtaining a right is not the end. The goal is to make it work for the business.
home.aboutBody: The attorney in charge works with you from start to finish. We preserve the technical context, read the business stage and competitive landscape, and design both the right protection method and the route to value realisation.
home.quote: “We do not stop at registration. We make the right work in the real business.”
how: Direct access to the responsible attorney
IP strategy from a business perspective
home.visual:
Technology must be understood
before rights can be designed.
home.servicesBody: Each service connects to the next. Experience in transactions and exits changes how claims should be drafted from the outset.

services.title: Secure
services.body: Korean patent, utility model, design and trademark filing and registration, including office-action strategy.

services.title: Defend
services.body: Infringement analysis, opinions, design-arounds, warning-letter response, trials and litigation—before a dispute hardens.

services.title: Expand
services.body: PCT and national filings, specification translation and collaboration with trusted foreign associates in market-entry order.

services.title: Realise
services.body: Valuation, sale-oriented portfolio design, technology-listing review and IP-backed finance. Registration is not the finish line.

services.title: Korea entry
services.body: The responsible attorney handles Korean filings and disputes directly and communicates closely with foreign associates.

services.title: Annuities & renewals
services.body: Reliable overseas patent annuity and trademark renewal management through our local network.

home.valueTitle:
Not only advised on valuation—
experienced in doing it.
home.valueStat: share of intangible assets in S&P 500 enterprise value
home.valueBody: People who work beyond registration design filings differently. We consider proof of infringement, family structure and the transaction potential of the right from the beginning.
valuePaths: Patent design for a potential U.S. sale
